subject: Re: New evaluation champion & reset — MAP kickoff
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Liang <sophia@lumenai.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New evaluation champion & reset — MAP kickoff

Hi Sophia and Marcus,

Thanks again for the candid update earlier this week — and congrats on the new Data Platform lead, Marcus. Per our conversation, I wanted to re-kick the evaluation with a short, concrete mutual action plan (attached) so we can get the trial back on track with clear owners and dates.

High level:
- New champion: Marcus Chen (Data Platform) — primary decision owner for the POC.
- Redwood leads: Vivek (sales), Jordan (solutions engineering), Rachel (customer success).
- Goal: 3-week POC focused on ingestion + latency tests, quality gate using the shared eval set, and SLO review.
- Target close: 2027-05-20 (flexible — see timeline in attachment).

Attached is a short MAP draft with milestones, required artifacts, and success criteria. Key asks for LumenAI to confirm:
1) Champion acceptance of the timeline and roles.
2) Security contact for SOC2/SSO questions (we can loop Rachel in).
3) A 60–90 minute kickoff session next week to align on data, infra, and evaluation metrics.

I pasted the proposed timeline below and included a Calendly link if you'd like to pick a slot: https://calendly.com/vivek-kulkarni/30min

Proposed first-week milestones:
- Day 0–2: Kickoff + account access (service accounts/ingest spec)
- Day 3–7: Data onboarding + baseline inference run
- Day 8–12: Eval metrics & regression checks; latency profiling
- Day 13–21: Final results; next-steps decision workshop

If Marcus is in, could he confirm ownership and provide the best security contact? Jordan and Rachel — I tagged you for technical and compliance coordination.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment(s): 2027-04-22-MAP-draft.xlsx

From: Sophia Liang <sophia@lumenai.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Chen <mchen@lumenai.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New evaluation champion & reset — MAP kickoff

Vivek — thanks for the note and the MAP. Marcus and I reviewed this internally; he will be the champion moving forward.

Quick answers:
- Champion: Confirmed, Marcus Chen (mchen@lumenai.com).
- Security contact: myself for now, but I will loop in our infra security lead (Tara Patel) once times are locked—email is tara.patel@lumenai.com.
- Kickoff: Marcus and I can do a slot next Tuesday (Apr 27) 10–11am PT; I tried your Calendly but wanted to pencil this in directly.

A couple of asks before kickoff:
- Can you attach the SOC 2 summary and any SSO docs so our security team can preview?
- We have a small compliance clause around token logging; would you confirm default retention behavior in the trial?

Thanks — Marcus will join the kickoff and will be the point for decisions on scope.

—Sophia
Head of Product Partnerships, LumenAI
Sophia@lumenai.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Liang <sophia@lumenai.com>, Marcus Chen <mchen@lumenai.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 12:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New evaluation champion & reset — MAP kickoff

Thanks Sophia — great, welcome Marcus.

Jordan and Rachel — looping you two in to cover the technical onboarding and compliance items Sophia requested.

Jordan: can you prepare a short runbook for the first-week ingestion steps and a checklist for service-account permissions? If there's anything LumenAI needs to pre-provision (S3 access, IP allowlist), please call it out in the kickoff.

Rachel: attaching a SOC2 summary and our standard SSO/retention doc for preview. On retention: by default trial environments have 30-day token retention and logs are accessible only to the customer's designated security contacts — we can change that if you need a shorter window.

I've attached an updated MAP that adds the security owner field and splits the POC into two discrete test scenarios (ingest + inference stability). Please take a look and let me know if anything else should be on the scoreboard.

Proposed kickoff: Apr 27 10:00–11:00 PT, Zoom link (I'll send invite once Marcus confirms).

Thanks — Vivek

Attachment(s): SOC2-summary-2026.pdf; 2027-04-22-MAP-draft.xlsx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Liang <sophia@lumenai.com>, Marcus Chen <mchen@lumenai.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New evaluation champion & reset — MAP kickoff

Hi Sophia / Marcus — quick note from my side ahead of the kickoff to make the first week efficient:

Checklist (please confirm availability/access):
- A small S3 bucket or sample feed (5–10k rows) we can use to validate connectors and schema.
- Temporary IAM key with read-only access OR a presigned ingest endpoint.
- IP allowlist ranges for our test agent (I can provide our static egress list).
- Sample eval set: 500 labeled items for the baseline quality gate (we'll share the eval template).

I'll come to the kickoff with a 20-minute demo showing the fastest path to a baseline inference run and then we can spend the rest of the time on pass/fail criteria and next steps.

Also, for security: Rachel, can you confirm whether we'll need a separate NDA addendum for token-level telemetry retention shorter than 30 days?

Thanks — Jordan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New evaluation champion & reset — MAP kickoff

Vivek / team — thanks for the clear plan and for pulling the MAP together. Confirming kickoff on Apr 27 was great; I reviewed the updated MAP and SOC2 summary. A couple of quick items:

- We will provide a small S3 sample bucket and a 500-row eval set by EOD Monday (May 3).
- For retention: we prefer a 14-day token retention during the trial. Rachel, can you confirm whether Redwood accepts that as standard or if we need an addendum?
- Team ask: can Jordan document the minimal IAM permissions we need for the ingest role (policy snippet)?

If those items are ok, we are aligned to move forward to the POC. Vivek — please attach the finalized MAP snapshot and I'll mark the internal milestone in our tracking tool.

—Marcus Chen
Data Platform Lead, LumenAI
